- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:138-146 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The gate checks only the first linked issue when deciding whether a verified automation follow-up allows skipping the security pass.

- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:150-156, 243-247 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: Gate and report modes depend on `gh api user` to populate `SECURITY_PASS_AUTHOR_LOGIN`, but the supported `github.token` fallback may not provide a user identity.
  WHY: An empty login makes the gate hold with `markers_unverifiable` and makes report mode skip, leaving standalone PRs without a recovery path; severity is consistently MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/security-audit.yml:41-46 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The workflow’s explicit permissions omit `pull-requests: read` even though report mode uses `github.token` to look up the PR.
  WHY: Without `GH_PAT`, the PR lookup can be denied and report mode exits without posting a result marker or re-dispatching review.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:236-238 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: A failed PR lookup is treated as a genuine head mismatch, causing report mode to exit without posting an audit result.
  WHY: Transient API failures and rate limits can leave the PR held in `audit_pending` until the stale window; severity is consistently MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5721-5727 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The “Single-issue security pass” step does not pass `SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_STALE_HOURS` from repository variables to the helper.
  WHY: The helper therefore always uses its six-hour default, ignoring operator overrides; severity is consistently MAJOR.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:248-256 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: An empty `SECURITY_PASS_FINDINGS` value is classified as a failed audit, including when an audit legitimately skips because the commit is unchanged.
  WHY: The report can post a failed marker and burn security-pass cycles despite there being no findings; severity is NIT for both reviewers.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:140 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The gate checks only the first linked issue when deciding whether to skip the security pass for an automation follow-up.
  WHY: If that issue is a follow-up and a regular issue is also linked, the regular issue can proceed to auto-merge without a security audit.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:236-238 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: A failed pull-request lookup in report mode is treated as a `pr_head_mismatch` and exits without posting an audit result.
  WHY: Network, rate-limit, or token failures can be mistaken for a genuine head mismatch, wasting the audit cycle.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:150-155, 243-246 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: Gate and report modes require `gh api user --jq .login` to identify the pipeline account.
  WHY: With the `github.token` fallback, an unavailable user identity can hold the gate with `markers_unverifiable` and make report mode skip without posting a result.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5721-5727 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The security-pass step does not propagate `SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_STALE_HOURS` to the helper.
  WHY: An operator override is ignored and pending audits continue to use the six-hour default.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:248-256 | severity=NIT | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: An empty `SECURITY_PASS_FINDINGS` value makes report mode classify a successful audit as failed.
  WHY: Empty findings can result from malformed audit output or a logs read failure, but the audit itself may have succeeded.

- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR description says the gate checks a pending marker as stale after "SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_STALE_HOURS (default 6)". The README should document this as a configurable repository variable, and the workflow step should propagate it.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml lines 5721-5727 (env block of the Single-issue security pass step) and README.md repository variables table (near the SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED row added at line 148).
  Evidence of absence: The review_autofix.yml env block at lines 5721-5727 does not include SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_STALE_HOURS. The README.md LAST RUN DIFF adds SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED but no SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_STALE_HOURS row. A grep for PENDING_STALE across the repository (outside the script itself) returns no results. The agents.md log prefix entry is added but no variable contract entry.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:140-146 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: `single_pass_gate` checks only the first element of `LINKED_ISSUES_JSON` when deciding whether to skip the security pass for a verified automation follow-up.
  WHY: If a follow-up is first and a regular issue is also linked, the gate returns `hold=false` and the PR can reach auto-merge without the mandatory security pass.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:150-156, 243-247 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: Gate and report modes require `SECURITY_PASS_AUTHOR_LOGIN` from `gh api user`, which may be empty when using the supported `github.token` fallback.
  WHY: Installation tokens do not authenticate as a user, so the gate can permanently hold auto-merge with `markers_unverifiable` and report mode can skip.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:339-343 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The root hook lacks the assignment regex fix for `NAME+=value` present in the workflow-template copy.
  WHY: `COUNT+=1 git push` can bypass detection, and the root/template parity and command parsing tests fail, blocking the PR.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:189, 195, 207, 218, 236, 258, 282, 286 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The helper uses raw `gh api` and `gh workflow run` calls without `gh_retry` or sourcing `scripts/gh_helpers.sh`.
  WHY: Transient API failures during report-mode PR lookup can prevent posting the audit outcome or re-dispatching review, leaving the PR held until the stale window.

- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: A fresh pending marker holds auto-merge for up to SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_STALE_HOURS (default 6 hours) before treating the audit as lost and re-dispatching, as specified in the PR intent and changelog fragment.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml step "Single-issue security pass" env block (lines 5721-5727) and README.md repository variables table (around line 144).
  Evidence of absence: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml lines 5721-5727 omits SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_STALE_HOURS: ${{ vars.SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_STALE_HOURS || '6' }} from the step environment, and README.md table at line 144 omits documenting SECURITY_PASS_PENDING_STALE_HOURS as a repository variable. Any operator override in repository variables is ignored at runtime and the script always runs with the 6-hour fallback.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
